evidence_boundary: Symbolic algebra, numerical linear algebra, and classical state-vector simulation only; not quantum hardware validation and not a complete derivation of gravity or quantum gravity from E47.
notes: This report records the previously executed local validation run supplied to the user.
The repository validator is the canonical executable added alongside this report.
The Grassmann check uses a deterministic coordinate witness with the required dimensions, not the original sparse rational witness matrices.
The Einstein checks validate the Brinkmann vacuum family and profile independence, not the complete unmarked gauge-inequivalence theorem.
The quantum checks are classical state-vector simulation of the 125-dimensional Hilbert-space model, not quantum hardware execution.
